AUDIT-7 Lane 4 batch 3 progress — 126 valid PRs audited, 4 invalid payload references (2026-11-25)

This slice processed #7857, #7860, #7861, #7863 and #7864. All five are merged PRs and now carry the read-back `audit:complete` label:

- #7857 → #5861: board moderation decision record.
- #7860 → #5897: benchmark regression-gates/results-retention design.
- #7861 → #5797: fallback-tier latency budgets and measurement plan.
- #7863 → #5815: adapter/relay security-binding design.
- #7864 → #5854: per-target composition design record.

The PR bodies, diffs, comments, source issue/comment captures, verdicts and label readbacks are in [the continuation ledger](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7857-7864/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7857-7864.md), on the existing docs PR #14847.

Cumulative count: 126 valid PRs audited from 130 payload entries; four payload identifiers (#7667, #7668, #7693, #7694) are issues rather than PRs; 120 identifiers remain, next #7865. Earlier count corrections are recorded in comments 7156848591 and 7156775726.
